description:
Electrical theory, experiments and demonstrations.  Located in the UK with content that's often specific to the UK electrical industry.  100% original content.  No sponsored videos, no AI generated slop, no fake clickbait, no reviews of unrelated junk.

BEWARE SCAMS - official emails will end in @flameport.com and I don't contact people via YT comments or random messaging platforms with accounts set up last week.

All official social media and messaging channels are listed at https://flameport.com/john_ward_electrician/contact/socialmedia.cs4 - if it's not listed there, then it's fake.
For important messages please use email or Whatsapp.  Messages sent on other platforms may not be responded to quickly or ever, as some services receive large quantities of junk.
